commands.feed.add.description: Watch a repository and backfill its releases here
commands.feed.description: Push GitHub release notes into a thread
commands.feed.param_target: Where to post; defaults to where you run this
commands.feed.sync.description: Post releases newer than the cursor
feed.add.done: Watching **{repo}**, posting to {channel}; backfilled **{count}** past releases. Use `/feed sync {repo}` for new ones (until the listener service is wired in).
feed.add.no_releases: Watching **{repo}** (posting to {channel}), but this repository has no releases yet.
feed.add.title: Subscribed
feed.bad_repo: `{value}` does not look like a repository. Use `owner/name`, for example `furryaxw/SprocketModManager`.
feed.bad_target: This location cannot receive posts: run the command in a text channel or thread, or pass `target`.
feed.cannot_post: I cannot send messages (or embed links) in {channel}. Grant both there and retry.
feed.channel_gone: The target channel `{channel}` is gone — it was probably deleted. Bind a new one with `/feed add`.
feed.fetch_failed: Could not fetch releases for **{repo}** (HTTP {status}). Is the name right, and is the repository public? If it is rate limiting, setting `GITHUB_TOKEN` raises the quota from 60 to 5000 requests per hour.
feed.list.empty: Nothing watched yet. Run `/feed add owner/name` inside the target thread.
feed.list.title: Watched repositories
feed.list.watch_off: *Listener service: not configured — push new releases with `/feed sync <repo>`.*
feed.remove.done: Stopped watching **{repo}** (messages already posted are kept).
feed.remove.title: Unsubscribed
feed.sync.nothing: **{repo}**: no releases newer than the cursor.
feed.sync.title: Synced
feed.truncated: *(truncated; full notes via the link on the title)*
modules.github_feed.description: Push GitHub release notes per repository into a chosen thread or channel (binding backfills the history).
modules.github_feed.name: GitHub release feed
